Name: Ton O' Fish (TOF)
Author: Kreestijan
Description:
[center][size=5][b]Ton O' Fish[/b][/size][/center]

[b]Description[/b]
[line]
Ton O' Fish proposes to add a bunch of new fishes to the game, said fishes are more often than not fantasy like and not anchored in reality. 

Girlfriend's favorite activity in our favorite farming game is not farming it seems but fishing and she demands more.
So that's what I'm going to do, add more fish to the game.

DSS is a requirement because I could not for the life of me draw what I wanted to in 16x16, I really tried, fishes are 32x32.
It's possible some fishes may end up unbalanced so there's a per fish toggle to enable/disable any one fish.

[color=#ff7700][size=4]Currently this content pack adds a measly [s]2 4 6 8[/s] [s]9[/s] 10 fishes to the game, I am going to add more constantly but you should know this now to decide if it's worth the hassle of adding it to your mod list in its current state.[/size][/color]

[color=#ffffff]I highly recommend both [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38752]Aquatic Sea Fish[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3578]More New Fish[/url] as well as both have served as inspiration for me.[/color]
